summary: Build variable names dynamically by concatenating strings with ~ inside hostvars[inventory_hostname][...], for example to read the ansible_<interface> fact for an interface passed in; interface names with dashes use underscores in fact names.
questions: How do I read a fact whose name depends on a variable?
How do I get the IP of an interface name passed as a role parameter?
Why can't I find the fact for interface eth-1?

answer_card.title: Build variable names dynamically
answer_card.answer_md:
Concatenate with `~` and look it up in `hostvars`:

```jinja
{{ hostvars[inventory_hostname]['ansible_' ~ which_interface]['ipv4']['address'] }}
```

Fact names use **underscores** where interface names have dashes, so convert, e.g. `which_interface | replace('-', '_')`.
